title: The Seven Bowls
intro: The seven bowls contain God's wrath—the final judgment over the earth before Christ's return.

items.title: Sores
items.text: Foul and painful sores on those who have the mark of the beast.

items.title: The Sea Turns to Blood
items.text: The sea turns into blood like that from a dead body. All life in the sea dies.

items.title: The Rivers Turn to Blood
items.text: The rivers and springs turn into blood. "They have poured out blood—now they are given blood to drink."

items.title: Scorching Sun
items.text: The sun scorches people with fire, but they do not repent.

items.title: Darkness Over the Beast's Kingdom
items.text: The beast's kingdom is plunged into darkness. They gnaw their tongues in pain.

items.title: Euphrates Dries Up
items.text: The river dries up to make way for the kings from the east. Armageddon.

items.title: It Is Done!
items.text: Earthquakes, hail, Babylon falls. A voice from the throne: "It is done!"
